sources.title: Transformer Math 101
sources.note: EleutherAI blog; canonical per-component training memory accounting with exact byte formulas and activation recomputation variants

sources.title: The Ultra-Scale Playbook: Training LLMs on GPU Clusters
sources.note: HuggingFace/nanotron; 4-component memory anatomy, activation formula m_act=L·seq·bs·h·(34+5·n_heads·seq/h), GPT-3 selective recompute 70%/2.7% claim

sources.title: ML Engineering — Memory Usage Anatomy
sources.note: Stas Bekman open book; 18 B/param floor, 6-component taxonomy, Llama-3-8B activation memory worked example (31 GB vs 240 GB)

sources.title: Mixed Precision Training
sources.note: Micikevicius et al. ICLR 2018; fp32 master weights, loss scaling, three-copy layout; foundation of modern mixed-precision training

sources.title: FP8-LM: Training FP8 Large Language Models
sources.note: Peng et al. 2023; E4M3/E5M2 formats, per-tensor dynamic scaling, 39% memory reduction GPT-175B, H100-only constraint

sources.title: Liger Kernel: Efficient Triton Kernels for LLM Training
sources.note: LinkedIn/Liger; fused linear cross-entropy eliminates B·T×V logit spike; 60-80% memory reduction; chunked Triton kernel

sources.title: Training Deep Nets with Sublinear Memory Cost
sources.note: Chen et al. 2016; O(sqrt(n)) activation memory via gradient checkpointing, one extra forward pass cost, 48 GB → 7 GB on 1000-layer ResNet

sources.title: Reducing Activation Recomputation in Large Transformer Models
sources.note: Korthikanti et al. 2022; selective recomputation + sequence parallelism, 5x activation memory reduction, >90% recompute overhead eliminated, 530B GPT-3 validation
